text:
Emily (AE): Heads-up — FinData wants EU-only residency for their POC; they asked for subprocessors list + whether routing/failover can touch US and any extra fees. @Josh (SE) can you confirm?

Sara (FinData): Yep. Requirements: 1) data must not leave EU for processing during normal ops; 2) KMS keys hosted in EU; 3) full subprocessors list by region. Also need a rough delta to pricing for 'region-pin' during the POC. Thx

Josh (SE): Short answer: our default hosted tier can route across regions for failover. We can pin tenant to eu region for the POC but there are tradeoffs. Need infra/legal confirm on subprocessors + KMS options. Pinning on Dedicated/Private is straightforward. I'll loop in @Nate (Infra).

Nate (Infra): We can do EU-only for POC. Two notes: (a) routing policy key `region_preference` -> `strict` keeps ingress+processing in EU; (b) strict mode currently requires Dedicated or Private deployment (hosted doesn't guarantee strict isolation for failover). Subprocessors (short list): `AWS eu-west-1`, `GCP europe-west4`, `CloudEdge FR (CDN/edge)`, `LogStore EU (logging/metrics)`. Will produce full inventory and network flow details.

Maria (Legal): For the security questionnaire, we need to provide the subprocessors list + DPA template. If they require guaranteed no-US-failover, call that out — we need to map whether Hosted can meet that (likely no) or Dedicated/Private is required. We support customer-managed KMS in EU via AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure KeyVault.

Emily (AE): @Sara — does FinData have flexibility to use Dedicated reserved capacity for a 30-day POC? That will make pinning + SLA much easier. If they want hosted free tier, strict EU-only may not be possible.

Sara (FinData): Prefer hosted initially to move fast, but if Dedicated short-term cost is reasonable we can consider it. What's a rough monthly delta for ~50k tokens/day POC?

Josh (SE): Quick back-of-envelope: hosted usage-based baseline ~= $X for that volume; Dedicated small pool baseline starts around $5k/mo depending on GPU type. Pinning/EU-only Dedicated could add a premium vs shared hosted; exact depends on model and instance type. I'll run numbers with finance and get a concrete quote.

Emily (AE): Action items: @Josh — finalize pricing delta; @Nate — export full EU subprocessors list + simple network flow diagram; @Maria — prep DPAs + KMS notes. I'll coordinate PO and timeline. Can we target EOD tomorrow for drafts?

Nate (Infra): On it. Partial draft now: `aws-eu-west-1: compute, storage; gcp-europe-west4: inference-accelerators; CloudEdge FR: cdn, edge-routing; LogStore EU: logs (retention 30d default)`. Uploading to shared folder: https://redwood.internal/fin-data/poc-subprocs :lock:

Josh (SE): Pricing nuance: if they accept hosted but with "soft affinity" (preferred EU but allow failover) cost impact is minimal. If they require strict EU-only we push them toward Dedicated/Private + customer KMS which increases cost but gives clear contractual guarantees.

Sara (FinData): That helps. For the security questionnaire we need an explicit sentence: "No customer content will be transferred outside the EU during normal operation; any failover that could route outside EU requires customer approval." Can you provide that?

Maria (Legal): I will draft that clause and add it into the DPA pack. Also will include a 30-day notification clause for subprocessor changes.

Emily (AE): :thumbsup: Okay — I'll book a sync with FinData for Wed 10:00 CET after we have numbers and the subproc doc. Thanks team.

redwood-bot: Reminder — uploaded files should not contain customer PII. Please mark the shared drive folder as restricted and log the upload.
